_note: Lengths in metres, speeds in m/s, impulses in N*s (mass x speed).

balls._note: a pool: the oldest ball comes back to the player's hands. 8 kg at 19 m/s is an impact of about 150 N*s.

wall._note: per block. An impact of J N*s above `threshold` T takes 100 x (J - T) / T health: here about 150 a throw, so a block of 320 falls to the third hit. hp_spread 0.15 = each block is up to 15 % tougher or weaker, drawn from the run's seed.
